title: Sanctuaire sylvestre
style: Soft painterly stadium diorama, original design: no text, logos, ball emblems or recognisable venue. Crowd as a soft colour mass. Values one to two steps darker than the pixel-art creatures, calm and low-contrast behind them (stands band and landmark base), detail and the brightest accents kept to the upper sky and the edges.
plate: Golden hour in a forest clearing. A colossal ancient tree stands backlit in the centre, its dark trunk rimmed with gold, its canopy framing the top of the sky; sun shafts fall through hazy golden air over a distant tree line. Wooden terraces under leafy eaves, lantern poles with warm glows.
court: Mossy flagstone court: rounded stones with moss and grass in the joints, soft sun dapples, warm cream markings and a carved six-rhombus sigil.
value: Very bright centre sky with a dark trunk silhouette, dark canopy corners, mid stands.
